scenes.name: Rocket exit room
scenes.description: Inside the rocket at the exit hatch. A generous viewport clearly shows the landing ground and distant town. The landscape stays visible with the cabin light off.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Your little vessel has brought you across the dunes. Beyond its brass-rimmed window lies Sarabesh. Turn towards the wheel on the hatch when you’re ready to step outside.

scenes.name: Landing ground
scenes.description: Outside the rocket, at the settlement edge. Looking back reveals the same hatch and viewport; the town entrance is ahead.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Warm sand, weathered machinery and the first glimpse of Sarabesh. Your rocket rests behind you; the crooked skyline ahead marks the way into the city.

scenes.name: Sarabesh City Plaza
scenes.description: The desert town hub. Keep the original positions and entrances of the residence, grocery, caravanserai and motel.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Sarabesh rises from the desert in a tangle of copper pipes, domes and improbable towers. Its water has fallen silent. For now, wander its doorways and discover the places waiting within.

scenes.name: Cogswash foyer
scenes.description: Residence entrance, with a route upstairs and a separate kitchen doorway. Daylight enters through the exterior doorway glazing; confirm the glazing in the polish pass.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: The Cogswash residence opens around a winding staircase, worn rugs and intricate brass fittings. The kitchen lies nearby; the stairs lead up to the living quarters.

scenes.name: Cogswash kitchen
scenes.description: Ground-floor kitchen off the foyer. Preserve the visible window and kitchen identity.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: A well-used kitchen wrapped in warm timber, hanging pans and curious pipework. Daylight reaches the worktops through the windows. Try the light lever, or turn the time dial to see the room change.

scenes.name: Living quarters
scenes.description: Upstairs in Cogswash Residence. The outward opening leads to the existing valley-view viewpoint.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Books crowd the shelves of these quiet living quarters. A comfortable chair, a writing desk and a view across the rooftops make this a good place to pause. The open window leads to the balcony.

scenes.name: Valley window view
scenes.description: An upper-floor outward-looking viewpoint at the residence window. Return only to the living quarters. This is the existing valley view, not an assumed Paris destination.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Above the streets, the valley opens beyond an ornate brass railing. Look back through the glass to see the living quarters, or watch the city shift from morning gold to night-time blue.

scenes.name: Clockwork Caravanserai
scenes.description: Town tavern reached through its original street entrance. Exterior-facing glazing keeps a relationship to local daylight.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: The Clockwork Caravanserai offers polished wood, bottles and a forest of pipes overhead. Sunlight falls across its tables by day; warm lamps draw the room together after dark.

scenes.name: Mechaniker Grocery
scenes.description: Town grocery reached through its original street entrance. Preserve the shop layout; confirm whether daylight reaches it through glazing during polish.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Behind the Mechaniker Grocery’s doors, jars, provisions and elaborate machinery share the shelves. Look up to the tall windows and vaulted ceiling, then follow the green light back to the city.

scenes.name: Motel-404
scenes.description: Motel entrance hall reached from town. Preserve the hallway, rooms and original return doorway; confirm daylight access during polish.
scenes.productionStatus: POC panorama and lighting states complete
scenes.visitorDescription: Motel-404 is a quiet refuge of curved metal corridors, shelves and softly worn furnishings. There are more doors than answers here. In this first exploration, only the entrance hall is open.
